1.title: Unit 1: I Can Do It by Myself

questions.explanation: Incorrect. After can, use the base verb: 'I can cook dinner.'
Incorrect. No -s after can: 'He can wash the dishes.'

questions.text: I can to walk to school.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Do not use 'to' after can: 'I can walk to school.'
Incorrect. Never add -s to can: 'She can set the table.'
Good! Questions: Can + subject + base verb?
Incorrect. They uses 'are': 'They are blowing bubbles.'

questions.text: I am lying in the sun.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. Add -ing: 'We are enjoying the picnic.'
Incorrect. She uses 'is': 'She is writing a letter.'

3.title: Unit 3: What Do You Do After School?
3.description: Frequency adverbs: always, usually, often, sometimes

questions.text: I usually play catch after school.
questions.explanation: Good! Adverb before the main verb.
Incorrect. Put the adverb before the verb: 'I often play chess.'
Incorrect. Put 'always' after I: 'I always do housework.'

questions.text: They usually have fun after school.

questions.explanation: Good! Frequency adverb before the verb.

4.title: Unit 4: When I Grow Up
4.description: want to be, will + base verb

questions.text: I want to be a teacher.
She want to be a singer.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. 'She wants to be a singer.'
Incorrect. Use 'an' before a vowel sound: 'I will be an astronaut.'

questions.text: When I grow up, I will save people.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. After will, no -s: 'He will perform on stage.'

questions.text: I want to be a firefighter.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. No 'to' after will: 'She will be famous.'

questions.text: They want to share their food.
I wants to be a chef.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. I uses 'want': 'I want to be a chef.'

5.title: Unit 5: My Secret Closet
5.description: there is / there are, in / on / under

questions.text: There is a trophy on the top shelf.
There are a T-shirt in the closet.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. One T-shirt: 'There is a T-shirt in the closet.'

questions.text: My cap is on the shelf.
There is many game cards in the box.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Plural: 'There are many game cards in the box.'

questions.text: The gloves are under the travel bag.
My racket are in the closet.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. One racket: 'My racket is in the closet.'

questions.text: There is a drone next to the trophy.
The clothes is on the shelf.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Clothes are plural: 'The clothes are on the shelf.'

questions.text: There are two caps on the top.
I like yogurt because it is sour.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. Popcorn is usually uncountable here: 'Popcorn is crunchy.'
Incorrect. After don't, use the base verb: 'I don't like soda.'
Incorrect. Nachos are plural: 'Nachos are spicy.'

questions.text: This dessert is fresh and sweet.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. It/the yogurt + -s: 'The yogurt tastes sour.'

questions.text: I feel glad because my classmate is kind.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. Use an adjective, not an adverb: 'I feel sad today.'

questions.text: She is scared of the noisy dog.
He feel nervous before the exam.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. 'He feels nervous before the exam.'

questions.text: I am excited about the party.
The room is gloomy and dark.
I feel angrily at my neighbor.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Use the adjective: 'I feel angry at my neighbor.'

questions.text: She feels sad because her toy is missing.
I feel nervous, but I can do it.

8.title: Unit 8: My Robot Friend
8.description: can + chores, put away / turn off

questions.text: The robot can write a letter.
It can turning off the light.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. After can, use the base verb: 'It can turn off the light.'

questions.text: The robot can solves a math problem.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. No -s after can: 'The robot can solve a math problem.'
Incorrect. No 'to' after can: 'It can recycle cans.'
Incorrect. Add -s, or use can: 'The robot plays a song' / 'The robot can play a song.'

questions.text: I can help my robot friend.
